description_en: Manually executes remediation for a specified rule in an account group
description_zh: 手动执行指定的账号组规则修正
kebab_example: aliyun config start-aggregate-remediation --config-rule-id cr-6b7c626622af00b40000 --aggregator-id ca-6b4a626622af00120000 --resource-id vpc-xxx --resource-type ACS::VPC::VPC --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-account-id 1002718975420000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartAggregateRemediation

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For information about how to obtain the rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en: The resource ID specified for single-resource remediation, such as vpc-xxx
parameters.help_zh: 单资源维度修正时指定的资源 ID，例如 vpc-xxx
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type specified for single-resource remediation, such as ACS::VPC::VPC
parameters.help_zh: 单资源维度修正时指定的资源类型，例如 ACS::VPC::VPC
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource specified for single-resource remediation, such as cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 单资源维度修正时指定的资源地域 ID，例如 cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the resource ownership to execute remediation on. If this parameter is left empty, non-compliant resources of all accounts in the account group are remediated.

The account can only be the current enterprise management account or a member account within the current enterprise management account's member accounts
parameters.help_zh:
要执行修正的资源归属的阿里云账号ID，该参数为空时表示修正账号组内所有账号的不合规资源。

该账号只能是当前企业管理账号或当前企业管理账号中的成员账号
parameters.name: resource_account_id

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Data.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
